name: Worldforged Anchorfoot Greaves rest on the ground in the Hinterlands (#9596)
contract: The pickup (gameobject entry at guid 6940042, item 515692/515885) sat 2.18 yd below the stock Hinterlands terrain at its XY: spawn_ground_gap read a gap outside the normal grounded tolerance and spawn_placement reported under_ground. The fix raises position_z to the measured ground height so the gap returns to tolerance and the chest opens.

steps.label: it rests on the ground, well inside the grounded tolerance
